# Demo_Site

Website + Digital Growth Platform for Saudi/GCC SMBs.

## Product
- [README](https://github.com/Midosd249/Demo_Site/blob/refactor/website-growth-platform/README.md): product scope, truth rules and local test.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Midosd249/Demo_Site/blob/refactor/website-growth-platform/AGENTS.md): operating and safety rules for coding agents.
- [Data model](https://github.com/Midosd249/Demo_Site/blob/refactor/website-growth-platform/docs/DATA.md): additive Supabase growth data contract.
- [QA checklist](https://github.com/Midosd249/Demo_Site/blob/refactor/website-growth-platform/QA_CHECKLIST.md): validation requirements.

## Important
This repository is the application source, not a public production deployment. Do not infer a public URL, rankings, customer data, or AI-model results from repository contents.
